429.description: Too many credential attempts for this username/IP.
Too many credential attempts for this username/IP.

post.summary:
Finish a login whose remaining factor was granted out of band (web
user approval from another device). The approve endpoint runs in the
approver's session, so it cannot authorize the requester's HTTP
session; the requester calls this once its auth state reports
`Success`.

Confirm OTP enrollment. Requires a live code for the
server-generated secret started by [`Self::api_begin_otp`]; only then
is the credential persisted and the policy upgraded to require OTP.

Start OTP enrollment. The server generates the secret,
stashes it pending confirmation, and returns only a provisioning URI.
The client must then prove possession via [`Self::api_create_otp`].

get.summary:
Sessions owned by the calling user, newest first. Management HTTP
sessions are excluded, as in the admin list.

BeginOtpEnrollment.description:
Response of starting an OTP enrollment: an `otpauth://` provisioning URI
for the server-generated secret. The raw secret is never returned.

old_password.description:
The caller's current password, re-verified before the
change is applied (a session alone must not be enough).

ConfirmOtpCredential.description:
The secret is generated server-side; enrollment is confirmed
by sending a live code from the authenticator, proving possession.

http_proxy_base_domain.description:
Base domain of the HTTP-proxy listener (`<target>.<base_domain>`),
when the proxy is enabled and a base domain is configured. Lets the
frontend build a per-target proxy URL. `None` if the proxy is off or
has no base domain.

site_title.description:
Configured site title; `None` means the built-in "Gated". Public so
the login page can show it.

terminal_watermark_enabled.description:
When true, the web terminal renders a frontend-only operator-identity +
timestamp watermark overlay. Defaults to false.

csr_pem.description:
PEM-encoded PKCS#10 certificate signing request. The CSR's
self-signature proves the requester holds the matching private key
(proof-of-possession); the certificate is issued over the CSR's public
key.

TargetHttpOptions.description:
Unified HTTP-reverse-proxy target. `flavor` toggles Kubernetes-specific
behaviour (channel.k8s.io WebSocket, watch streaming, exec/attach
recording enrichment).

ca_certificate.description:
Optional PEM bundle of CA certificates trusted for the upstream
connection (e.g. an in-cluster signing CA).

flavor.description: Protocol-level behaviours unlocked for this target.

tls.description:
TLS settings for the upstream connection. `tls.verify` defaults to
`true`; set it to `false` only for a target with a self-signed or
otherwise unverifiable cert.

upstream_auth.description: How Gated authenticates to the upstream service.

url.description:
Upstream base URL (e.g. `https://kubernetes.example.com` for K8s,
or any http(s) origin for generic targets).

readonly.description:
When true, the SQL Console rejects anything not starting with
SELECT / SHOW / EXPLAIN / WITH. This is convenience-level only —
use a real read-only DB user for hard guarantees.
